local_review.finding_body: The generated proxy scenarios instantiated a test-local SimpleProxyManager, called java.lang.reflect.Proxy directly, and asserted the test implementation's behavior rather than behavior implemented by org.apache.aries.proxy.api. This violated FS-test-contract.1.3 and FS-test-contract.2.1 and produced test-only proxy metadata that did not justify target-library behavior.
local_review.finding_title: Test-local proxy implementation creates false library coverage
local_review.fix_note: Removed the test-local ProxyManager implementation and its direct-reflection scenarios, retained the meaningful FinalModifierException and UnableToProxyException public-API coverage, and removed the now-unjustified test-only reachability metadata. Stable Forge finalization passed afterward.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff and resolved evidence. The repaired suite exercises the target library's concrete exception behavior from a separate test package, has no scaffold, native skip, version-pinned assertion, build/run flag, or legacy metadata file. Reported dynamic access is the valid 0/0 no-calls case. The exact Forge finalization command completed all three native lanes, metadata and style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics without further publishable changes.
